recipes.name: Quick and Simple Broccoli and Cheese
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen broccoli florets, thawed
3 tablespoons butter, melted, or to taste

steps.text: Place broccoli in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water and cover. Cook until tender but still firm, 2 to 6 minutes. Drain and transfer to a microwave-safe casserole dish.
Pour melted butter over broccoli and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle cheese over the top and microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 1 minute.

raw_recipe.headline: Quick and Simple Broccoli and Cheese
raw_recipe.description: This is an easy broccoli and cheese recipe that anyone can make. Turn eating your veggies into a treat that kids and grown ups alike will love.

video.description: Steam broccoli crowns then add them to a microwaveable safe dish with melted butter, salt, pepper, and shredded cheddar cheese! Perfect, cheesy side dish!

review.reviewBody: Definitely quick and definitely simple - a classic combination for a great side dish. Not to mention it's a great way to camouflage a healthy veggie in case you have picky eaters in your house! I used a steam in bag of broccoli and whether you use velvetta or another of your favorite cheeses this stuff is great!

I like this recipe because it does NOT use Velveeta, which is "processed" and questionable. I used fresh broccoli, sharp cheddar, and 2 Tblsps butter. I microwaved the fresh broccoli florets (2 Tblsps water, cover microwave dish) for 90 seconds, drained water, poured melted butter over broccoli, then topped with cheese. Recovered dish and microwaved for about 45 seconds. Done! Very fresh taste.

I always use Velveeta instead. Shredded Cheddar would not result in a very desirable consistency. No butter, just a little milk or half and half and fresh broccoli. Want your kids to scarf down broccoli without being prodded? Use this recipe - my kids almost begged for it growing up!

I just made this as a potato topping. It turned out great! For two smallish heads of broccoli I added a little water to the bowl (2 tbsp), microwaved on high 90 secs, drained, added the 1 tbsp melted butter, cheese, plus salt/pepper/garlic powder and about 2 tbsp of sour cream (Mexican style) before topping with the cheese and microwaving for another 45 seconds. Came out super creamy and pretty much perfect!

It's not good on it's own but it's a nice base to start off of making a great cheddar sauce. I did the butter then added half a block of cream cheese, 3/4 ths a block of cheddar then added heavy whipping cream as needed to get the right consistency. Was delicious.

My mom has made broccoli and cheese this way my whole life. I like it, but I don't love it. It just isn't quite as cheesy. I prefer to make a cheese sauce myself out of cheese, milk and butter for a really good broccoli and cheese. If I'm just throwing together something quick to eat with a weeknight dinner, I cut Velveeta into cubes and toss it in with the broccoli after I've drained it, then put the lid on and put it on the burner on "Warm", stir it up, then serve. Even though the cheese is processed and some people don't like that, I definitely think it's a better way than this method.

This is a standard weekly dish here. IF you want to get the full nutritional benefits DO NOT microwave the broccoli - it destroys all of the benefits and some of the protein. Same with boiling it. STEAM the broccoli, it's definitely worth the effort - 5 or so minutes depending on how soft you like the broccoli. Melt your sharp cheddar (or whatever cheese you want) in the microwave if need be, otherwise leave it unplugged. Broccoli is LOADED with great nutrition that's undeniably worth the effort and a few minutes more time. I salt & pepper mine ( iodized salt & crack my own pepper). If you're concerned about microplastics sea salt has one of the highest levels of microplastics. Do an online search & use critical thinking.

I made this last night as a side dish. I used fresh broccoli. I boiled the broccoli on the stove and then melted butter in the microwave. And put the cooked broccoli in a 1.5 qt dish and poured the butter over the broccoli then added reduced fat cheddar cheese and microwaved for 30 seconds. It turned out great I will make this way from now on.

Got what I was looking for. Simple, easy and quick. Less than ten minutes.
Used steam in a bag broccoli and cooked it less than called for by 1 and 1/2 minutes. Lightly seasoned with sea salt and black pepper and a little bit of lemon juice. Then, topped with the cheese. No complaints!!

I made this at my son's request. This was easy, but needed a little help. I used American/Cheddar-Jack blend and added some cubed Velveeta as well because it needed more cheese and wasn't creamy enough for us. I cooked mine on the stove according to pkg directions and then drained off the water and added the cheese and melted it on low heat. My son loved this dish!

This recipe was very tasty will make it again.
